 Should you kill or spare Benedict Halifax in GTA 6? 
 ❚ We may earn commission from links on this page. Our editorial is always independent ( learn more ). Should you kill or spare Benedict Halifax in GTA 6?
 A wild goose chase.
 Rockstar Belle Law 
 Published: Friday, 20 November 2026 at 12:41 pm Stay ahead of the game! Sign up for our FREE gaming newsletter Share on facebook 
 Share on twitter 
 Share on pinterest 
 Share on reddit 
 Email to a friend 
 After hunting down Benedict Halifax not once, but twice, after he scams you by stealing the statue you gave him to appraise, you might not be feeling too fond of the dubious man.
 Ad And after escaping via boat, crashing it and then stealing a golf cart instead, Halifax certainly sends Lucia and Jason on a wild goose chase after him.
 Regardless, he might not deserve a brutal murder, but when you add a few rewards into the mix… the more violent option can certainly be tempting.
 So, is it worth killing Halifax? Or should you spare him? Keep reading to hear our thoughts on what you should do.
 Should you kill or spare Benedict Halifax in GTA 6? 
 The choice it totally up to you, but we would recommend killing Halifax. 
 Not only is he a lying little weasel, but nothing bad happens if you kill him – life in Leonida goes on. Plus, you can steal everything in his lockup.
 However, it seems as though if you spare him, you can still get everything he has to his name, so really it doesn’t matter! You will still get the $2,500 in jewellery and cash from the storage container, and you can steal and sell the '32 Hustler parked out front.
 The only thing that killing him might affect is your criminal profile level , but this fluctuates and won’t have much of an impact.
 It’s unknown whether Halifax ever returns if you spare him, but we haven’t heard about him making his grand return yet!
